term.zh-CN: 薄肌、大水、大睡：为什么生活也开始讲“理论”？
term.en: Why do everyday choices become internet “theories”?

meaning.zh-CN: 一个生活选择，如何变成一套流行话语？从网络说法的语境与传播方式读起，再回到自己的日常经验。网络热词是文化观察对象，不是科学定论。
meaning.en: How does an everyday choice become a shared expression? Read its context and circulation, then return to your own experience. Internet catchphrases are cultural observations, not established scientific findings.

related_label.en: My related essay: The Great Walk Theory
